leadText:
Kiawe's family's ranch is a Moomoo Milk dairy farm on Akala Island in the Alola region, where and his family live and work. It is located close to Wela Volcano Park, and its fertile volcanic soil helps to raise the ranch's grazing Pokémon. 

The ranch first appeared in Young Kiawe Had a Farm!, where visited it and helped Kiawe out with some farm chores. While Kiawe's father, Rango, is the president of the farm, Kiawe is very much involved with the facilities upkeep. Kiawe uses his to air deliver the Moomoo Milk products every morning, including cheeses and ice creams, to customers and restaurants across Alola including Aina's Kitchen. The ranch prides itself on its quality and freshness.

In The Ol' Raise and Switch!, Kiawe took Lana's Popplio to his ranch as part of a school project, where his class temporarily traded their partners. Although Kiawe at first had trouble figuring out what to do with Popplio, it eventually proved its usefulness by calming down a pair of fighting .

The ranch reappeared in Big Sky, Small Fry!, where Kiawe alongside , , and , who wanted to try out its various Moomoo Milk products, including cheese and ice cream, during a class excursion to Akala Island.

The ranch appeared again in The Young Flame Strikes Back!, when businessman Viren attempted to buy the ranch from Kiawe and his family to construct his own resort hotel, but was declined. Viren then commanded his henchmen to harass the family, and resorted to stopping the farm's water supply in a bid to obtain the farm. Eventually they were arrested and charged by Officer Jenny for forging land owner documents, trespassing, and malicious destruction to property.

In SM103, when Ash and visited the ranch as a part of and sightseeing tour of the Alola region. Brock was immediately impressed by the ranch's facilities, and took a tour of its stables and pens. Later, a started to scare the after its baby had become injured, but Brock was able to heal the infant's swollen leg.
